integrity: The proof is structural and separates the graph into order-p-line clique blocks plus the cyclic-q transversal. Exhaustive finite searches independently reconstruct the power relation and verify all three minima in five representative groups.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to direct products of an elementary abelian p-group and a cyclic group of distinct prime order.
No formula is asserted when either Sylow factor has the more complicated power structure of a higher prime-power group.
The ordinary domination value is compatible with later general domination results; the new content is the exact total and paired values and their matching obstruction.
title: Domination gaps in proper power graphs of elementary-by-cyclic groups
